name: Omarchy Proton
author: ralphk-86
description: Proton VPN over WireGuard in the bar. Your regular traffic uses either your own IP ("Normal connection") or a Proton server's IP, whichever you pick in the panel, with a kill switch while a server is selected. qBittorrent always goes through its own separate tunnel. Drop .conf files into a folder and press Refresh. Unofficial.

barWidget.description: Shows the external IP of your regular traffic (your own, or the selected server's) and of the torrent tunnel. Left-click opens the panel: pick a server or Normal connection, import configs, check for leaks. Right-click toggles the VPN.

schema.label: Show IP addresses in the bar
schema.description: Off shows only the status icons.
